subject: Warehouse cost clarity + demo schedule
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@snowcorp.com>, Tara Voss <tara@lookerpartners.io>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Warehouse cost clarity + demo schedule

Team / partners —

We have our June renewal window coming up for ACME Media's analytics stack (SnowCorp + Looker currently, with a Metabase PoC running in a few teams). Before we commit to any multi-year capacity, procurement has asked for a clear cost breakdown and options that move the needle on unit economics.

Attached is the RFP (RFP-redwood-analytics-2026.pdf) with the usage profile and our key asks: predictable monthly run-rate at 95th/99th percentile, retention & audit log SLAs, and an option path for a metered burst model. Please review and respond with:
- A line-item price view (compute vs storage) and expected uplift for sustained concurrency vs short bursts
- Any committed-use discounts and minimums to qualify
- What a 6–12 week pilot would look like (scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria)

Sara/Tara: can you each send a short pricing packet and 45-minute demo slot availability this week? ACME procurement wants two vendor demos next Tue/Wed if possible.

Marcus / Laura / Monica: I need a thumbs up on budget range and primary evaluation criteria by EOD Fri so I can give the vendors direction.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Programs
Redwood Inference

[attachment: RFP-redwood-analytics-2026.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@snowcorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warehouse cost clarity + demo schedule

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the RFP and context. Attaching our pricing packet (SnowCorp_pricing_v3.pdf) which breaks compute, storage, and egress. Highlights:
- 20% baseline discount for a 12-month committed capacity at or above the usage profile in your RFP
- An annual commitment model reduces egress and micro-billing by ~18% vs on-demand for sustained query patterns
- We can offer a 6-week pilot with a capped pilot capex/usage of $12k and a dedicated TAM for migration support

Suggested demo slots: Tue 2026-06-23 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 2026-06-24 14:00–14:45 PT. The demo will include: architecture overview, query-concurrency tuning, and a short cost-simulation using your supplied Q1/Q2 traces.

Note: the attached PDF calls out optional add-ons (materialized view acceleration, cold-storage tiering) — these change savings estimates materially; happy to walk through.

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Enterprise Account Exec, SnowCorp

[attachment: SnowCorp_pricing_v3.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warehouse cost clarity + demo schedule

Thanks — quick internal note:

I reviewed the RFP usage profile and have a few asks for the vendor demos:
- Show the expected 95th vs 99th percentile cost deltas when we move from bursty to sustained concurrency (we hit those spikes every Wednesday ETL run)
- Break out long-term storage pricing separately; we have a number of low-temp tables that could be archived if moving to a cheaper tier helps the business case
- Confirm the effort & calendar days for migrating dependent Looker/Metabase queries (we have ~320 saved explores across teams)

Also attaching a usage snapshot (usage_snapshot_q1-q2.csv) with hourly tokenized query counts + average row scans so vendors can run realistic sims.

If procurement wants to cap spend during a pilot, we should communicate a $12k pilot cap and acceptance criteria up-front.

–Marcus
Principal Architect, Platform

[attachment: usage_snapshot_q1-q2.csv (CSV, 65KB)]
